mandatory_query_rules: PROTECTED BASELINE PAGE ID COUNT != FINAL PAGE COUNT
112 is a historical v1.11 snapshot, not the current complete Web carrier count.
Never answer 20, 52, 111 or 112 as the current final project page count.
When asked current Web page/surface count, answer current_complete_integrated_web_surface_count.status first; do not substitute the stale 112 snapshot.
When asked project page count, answer canonical_page_count.status first, then explain other counts by semantic role.
Newer file timestamp alone does not override this contract; only explicit newer Current Authority / PAGE REGISTER / Count Contract may supersede it.
